info.name: One-Time Login Applications Auth API
info.description: Login users using one-time login methods like magic links or OTPs. This implements a backend-to-backend integration for authentication.

request.description: Send a magic link by email to a user. Upon clicking the email link, the User Agent will be redirected to the requested redirect URI with a code (passed in the `code` query parameter). This code can be used to complete the authentication in the subsequent request.

**Required permissions**: `apps:execute`, `[appId]:execute`, `auth:execute`.
